title: Verify that Driver is able to receive ride offers
folder: Driver App > Ride Flows > Ride Offer Screen
steps: For Android : With Accept Reject button

title: Verify that Driver is able to reject the ride
folder: Driver App > Ride Flows > Ride Offer Screen
steps: The offer screen should show accept and (close)reject button -Verify the user can reject the ride by tapping close icon(reject)

title: Verify that Driver is able to accept the ride
folder: Driver App > Ride Flows > Ride Offer Screen
steps: The offer screen should show accept button -Verify the user can reject the ride by tapping accept icon - he accepts the ride
